gym.prompt: You are the front desk assistant of a gym.
gym.answer: Answer in one or two sentences, using only the given context.

docs.membership.md: The monthly membership costs 800 EGP. The yearly membership costs 7,200 EGP and includes a free towel service.
docs.hours.md: The gym is open every day from 6 am to 11 pm. On Fridays it opens at 2 pm instead.
docs.classes.md: Yoga classes are on Mondays and Thursdays at 7 pm. Spinning classes are on Tuesdays at 8 pm. Classes are included in every membership.
docs.trainers.md: A personal training session costs 300 EGP. A package of 10 sessions costs 2,500 EGP.
docs.freeze.md: Yearly members can freeze their membership for up to 60 days a year. Monthly members cannot freeze.
docs.guests.md: Members can bring one guest a month for free. Extra guests pay 150 EGP a visit.
docs.pool.md: The pool is open to women from 9 am to noon, and to everyone from noon to 9 pm.

travel.prompt: You are a customer service agent for a travel agency.
travel.answer: Answer in one or two sentences, using only the given context.

docs.sharm.md: The Sharm El Sheikh trip is 4 nights at a 5-star hotel, all inclusive, for 9,000 EGP a person. It leaves every Thursday.
docs.luxor.md: The Luxor and Aswan trip is 5 nights on a Nile cruise, full board, for 14,000 EGP a person. It includes the guided temple tours.
docs.turkey.md: The Istanbul trip is 6 nights at a 4-star hotel with breakfast, for 38,000 EGP a person. The flights are included, and the visa is not.
docs.children.md: Children under 6 travel free. Children from 6 to 12 pay 50% of the adult price.
docs.booking.md: A deposit of 25% confirms the booking. The rest is due 10 days before the trip.
docs.cancel.md: Cancelling more than 14 days before the trip gets a full refund. Later cancellations lose the deposit.
docs.contact.md: The office is open Saturday to Thursday from 10 am to 7 pm. The hotline is 16555.

docs.المنيو.md: ساندوتش الشاورما بـ90 جنيه، وطبق المشويات المشكل بـ280 جنيه، وعلبة الكشري بـ60 جنيه. مفيش أكل نباتي غير الكشري.
docs.المواعيد.md: المطعم فاتح كل يوم من 12 الضهر لـ2 بالليل. يوم الجمعة بيفتح الساعة 3 العصر.
docs.التوصيل.md: التوصيل في مدينة نصر ومصر الجديدة بس. سعر التوصيل 30 جنيه، ومجاني للطلبات فوق 300 جنيه. الطلب بيوصل في 45 دقيقة.
docs.العروض.md: يوم التلات فيه خصم 20% على طبق المشويات. وجبة العيلة بـ750 جنيه وبتكفي 4 أفراد.
docs.الحجز.md: الحجز للمجموعات من 6 أفراد أو أكتر بس. بتحجز قبلها بيوم على الأقل.
docs.الدفع.md: الدفع كاش أو فيزا في المطعم. التوصيل كاش بس.
